title: HeadDelta@1 payload
description: The kernel-derived relation between two consecutive heads of one node: exact from and to Snapshot IDs, the diff policy identity, the complete head-to-head path set with rename truncation metadata, and one mark per path over the union of the Notes paths and both Subject views. NOT a Change Set: it names no Base, carries no Subject identity and no Report Scope, and exists for whole-tree Subjects too.
x-semantic-constraints: changed_paths are strictly sorted and unique
marks are strictly sorted by path and unique
every changed path has a mark
renamed_from is present exactly on renamed marks and differs from the path
